scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n dashboard,mcp -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @clens/dashboard" "npm run dev -w @clens/mcp-server"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently --kill-others -n lens,lens-react,lens-angular,dashboard,mcp,react-example,angular-example -c magenta,cyan,purple,blue,green,yellow,yellow "npm run dev -w @clens/lens" "npm run dev -w @clens/react" "npm run dev -w @clens/angular" "npm run dev -w @clens/dashboard" "npm run dev -w @clens/mcp-server" "npm run dev -w example-react" "npm run dev -w example-angular"
scripts.dev:example: concurrently --kill-others -n react-example,angular-example -c yellow,yellow "npm run dev -w example-react" "npm run dev -w example-angular"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @clens/lens && npm run build -w @clens/react && npm run build -w @clens/angular && npm run build -w @clens/dashboard && npm run build -w @clens/mcp-server
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules example/*/dist example/*/node_modules node_modules
